items.text: A proposer posts a two hundred fifty dollar bond to say who won.
If it is wrong and nobody disputes it, it stands.
Gainsay checks the resolution before the bond goes up.
Evidence is bought with test U S D C on Sepolia.
It reads the proposal and buys the final score through Telegraph.
Holds. Flames two, Avalanche five.
Every answer carries a receipt, and one source is flagged as one.
Run on the first of November, after the window closed.
A second sport: Timberwolves one seventeen, Rockets one oh seven. The over holds.
It rejects answers about the wrong game.
Our first paid answers were about other games. Verified means unaltered, not correct.
Game not started: too early, nothing bought.
Not covered: it refuses, and buys nothing.
Six verdicts. Wrong has only happened in tests.
Watch lists every proposal in its challenge window, read from Polygon.
Read, buy, reject the wrong game, settle by arithmetic.
An outside developer added N F L and Champions League, through another team's miner.
On Solana, the venue's recorded result is treated as the proposal.
Gainsay buys the official score through Telegraph, and reads the on-chain result account.
It matches the A P I.
Fifteen Polymarket games: fourteen hold, one has no independent source, none wrong.
Gainsay is live, on testnet. No proposer has used it yet.
